newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: United Engineers in loan facility.
newsitem.headline: United Engineers in loan facility.

text.p: United Engineers Ltd said Thursday it had agreed to arrange for a term loan of up to Singapore $130 million to finance a construction project and also for working capital.
A company statement said United Engineers has entered into a loan agreement with Great Eastern Life Assurance Co, DBS Bank, OCBC Bank and the Overseas Assurance Corp (OAC) for the facility.
The proceeds will be used to part-finance the payment of construction costs incurred for its development of UE Square as well as for working capital.
Repayment of the loan has been scheduled over three years.
Three of the lenders namely Great Eastern Life, OCBC and OAC own shares in United Engineers.
